articles.title: Analyst Report: Capital One Financial Corp
articles.mainIdea: Analyst Report: Capital One Financial Corp
articles.summary: Argus Research: Analyst Report: Capital One Financial Corp. With about $683 billion in total assets and $490 billion in total deposits, Capital One is among the largest banks in the U.S., with top-tier national businesses in credit-card and auto lending and a retail and commercial banking presence in the New York, Metro D.C., and the Louisiana/Texas markets. Capital One's mix of loans is about 60% card loans, 20% consumer loans, and 20% commercial loans. COF currently has around 77,000 employees and its shares are included in the S&P 100 index. It is headquartered in McLean, Virginia. The company acquired Discover Financial Services in May 2025. Related tickers mentioned: COF-PK, COF-PL, COF-PN.
